title: Set the default web browser using xdg-settings
summary: Use xdg-settings to define which application opens web links and URLs. This ensures that clicking links in emails or documents opens your preferred browser.
prerequisites: Know the .desktop file name of your browser (e.g., firefox.desktop)

steps.explain: Set the default web browser to the specified application. Replace <BROWSER_DESKTOP> with the .desktop file name of your browser (e.g., firefox.desktop, chromium.desktop).

placeholders.name: BROWSER_DESKTOP
placeholders.description: The .desktop file name of the browser you want to set as default.
